conversation.text: How much is the maintenance plan?

According to the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md, effective 2026-01-01), the Standard plan is $189 per year per system, or $16.99 per month, and each additional system at the same address is $99 per year.
Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
Monthly plans require a 12-month minimum commitment.

Standard includes two seasonal tune-ups a year (one cooling, one heating), priority scheduling, the $89 diagnostic fee waived on service calls, 15% off all repairs, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
Plus adds an annual water heater flush and inspection, an annual whole-home plumbing inspection, and 15% off plumbing repairs.
Both Standard and Plus members get $500 off any full system replacement.
I thought it was $149?

The $149 figure may be the after-hours emergency dispatch fee, which is $149 for non-members according to the 2026 Repair Price Book (pricing/repair_price_book_2026.csv) and the 2026 Fee Schedule (pricing/2026_fee_schedule.pdf).
Comfort Club members don't pay that fee.
For membership, the 2026 Fee Schedule lists Comfort Club at $189 per year for one system, or $16.99 per month, and Comfort Club Plus at $269 per year, with no monthly option for Plus.
I don't have a $149 membership price in the documents.
